channel.title: Baris Uraz — sid206-toolkit
channel.description: Notes on reverse-engineering the Siemens SID206 ECU and Ford's Secondary Bootloader.

item.title: Reverse-engineering my car's ECU and tuning it from 130 to 190 HP myself
item.description: Dumping a 256 KiB SID206 calibration over OBD via Ford's official SBL and diffing it against stock exposed 57 silently disabled fault monitors, a ~10% gearbox torque under-report, and stripped protection limiters before rebuilding a clean ~190 PS calibration.

item.title: Kendi arabamın ECU'sunu tersine mühendislikle çözüp 130'dan 190 HP'ye nasıl çıkardım (TR)
item.description: Stok 2 MiB SID206 MPC561/MPC562 PowerPC dosyasını ve Ford SBL'ini (6G91-14C273-DH) çözerek aracın 256 KiB calibration bloğunu OBD'den okuma, 57 gizli DTC iptalini bulma ve ~190 PS temiz yazılım yazma süreci.
